neighbours.label: collective noun for a newly arrived group ('latest batch of', 'fresh crop of', 'new set of'); weak, and it also fires on code line ends
fire: This year's batch of interns started work on Monday.
A second batch of vaccines was shipped to the clinics.
The current crop of novels about the war is unusually strong.
Each new batch of students receives a welcome pack.
The latest crop of apps promises to organise your whole day.
Another batch of letters turned up in the attic.
The first batch of results will be published in May.
A new set of guidelines was issued to the staff.
quiet: The interns started work on Monday of this week.
The vaccines were shipped to the clinics in refrigerated vans.
Novels about the war are unusually strong this year.
Every student receives a welcome pack on arrival.
The app promises to organise your whole day.
Several letters turned up in the attic.
The results will be published in May.
The staff followed the guidelines carefully.

notes: Card: no single token (' batch', ' set', code line ends such as '():\n', volume numbers). Probing: 'batch of' 0.22-0.24, 'crop of' 0.21, 'set of' 0.30, '.items():' 0.31; 'round of', 'wave of', 'generation of' below 0.1. The readings sit at the judge's 0.20 line, so this may well fail.
